# Character scope, the future holder: a pool title of TIER (duchy, kingdom, empire) of their race is free.
aov_tribe_has_free_title_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_trait = race_orc
			aov_tribe_free_orc_$TIER$_trigger = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_trait = race_goblin
			aov_tribe_free_goblin_$TIER$_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}
